An obese man in his mid-30s with no prior systemic or ocular disorders presented to a local emergency department after waking with vision loss in his right eye. He also experienced pain, numbness, and erythematous induration of his right eyelids and forearm that increased throughout the day.

Visual acuity: No light perception in right eye (OD) and 20/20 in left eye (OS). Right eye showed tense eyelid edema, chemosis, corneal haze, and restricted motility in all fields of gaze.
